title: Local quasi-coherence of tensor pullback
statement: For every point x of X there is an open neighbourhood U such that the tensor pullback restricted over U is quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Fix x in X. Choose a neighbourhood on which G admits a presentation by free module sheaves. Restrict along the inverse image and apply inverse image followed by extension of scalars; both preserve coproducts and cokernels.

The pure-tensor identification sends b tensor a to b times g-sharp(a), with inverse b to b tensor 1, so the pulled-back presentation is a free presentation on a neighbourhood U of x. Thus the restriction over U is quasi-coherent.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorModulePullback_isQuasicoherent_local
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherent) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X, x ∈ U ∧
      ((SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf G)).over U).IsQuasicoherent
